title: Scoring Without the Engine: Validating a Deterministic, Manipulation-Resistant Content Score for Generative Engines, End to End
abstract: arXiv:2609.07559v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How do you validate a cheap, deterministic proxy for an oracle that is expensive, rate-limited, and non-stationary? We present a protocol built on adversarial falsification gates (negative control, dose response, bounded amplification, duplication penalty, length neutrality) that define and select the proxy, fitted on a training split and confirmed held-out; around them it bounds what the proxy can never resolve, and re-measures external causal evidence on the current oracle rather than assuming it. We demonstrate it end to end on Generative Engine Optimization, where the proxy is a deterministic content score, and one step fails on that domain exactly as the protocol is built to detect: re-measuring the only published causal anchors (2023 effect sizes) on ten modern engine families shows their levers move citation on none, so the anchors are an expired external check; recalibrating to the near-zero modern vector strips the score of its

translated_title: 无需引擎的评分：为生成式引擎端到端验证一个确定性、抗操纵的内容评分
translated_abstract: 你如何为一个昂贵、受速率限制且非平稳的神谕验证一个廉价、确定性的代理？我们提出了一套建立在对抗性证伪门（阴性对照、剂量响应、有界放大、重复惩罚、长度中性）之上的协议，这些证伪门用于定义并筛选代理，在训练集上拟合并在留出集上确认；围绕这些门，协议界定了代理永远无法解决的问题，并在当前的神谕上重新测量外部因果证据，而非假定其依然成立。我们在生成式引擎优化（GEO）任务上端到端地演示了该协议，其中代理即为一个确定性内容评分，协议中的一个环节恰如设计所预期的那样在该领域检测到了失败：在十个现代引擎家族上重新测量唯一已发表的因果锚点（2023年的效应量）表明，这些杠杆手段在任何一个引擎上都无法改变引用结果，因此这些锚点已是过期失效的外部检查；重新校准到接近零的现代效应向量后，该评分失去了其……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一套基于对抗性证伪门的端到端验证协议来检验生成式引擎优化的确定性内容评分代理，并发现2023年发表的唯一因果效应量锚点在十个现代生成式引擎上已全部失效，证明该评分无法通过外部因果证据的重新校准验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an end-to-end validation protocol based on adversarial falsification gates for a deterministic content score proxy in generative engine optimization, and shows that the only published 2023 causal anchors no longer move citations on any of ten modern engine families, rendering the proxy invalid under re-calibration.
